Gil wants to be a ninja, but his ninja teacher just keeps giving him random tasks to do; frustrated, Gil is about to give up when another ninja challenges him, and he realizes he's been learning ninja skills all along.

description:

The Bubble Guppies learn about dinosaurs.

description:

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S03 E26 — Pups Save Their Floating Friends; Pups Save a Satellite
Ryder and the pups must repair the aliens' spaceship and get everyone back to Earth; when a satellite begins to fall toward Adventure Bay, the PAW Patrol have to fix it before it crashes.

title: PAW Patrol
description:

When the postman's truck gets stuck in the mud, the mail is stuck in a tree; Mayor Goodway turns into a frog.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:

Café Carl opens up a smoothie shop on the boardwalk, but when the coaster causes coconut chaos, "Rubble & Crew" know just what to do; "Rubble & Crew" work together to find a construction solution when Charger's bouncy birthday surprise needs a lift.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S01 E23 — The Crew Builds a Giant Dam; The Crew Builds a Squirrel-Proof Farm
Rubble & Crew are on the job to save Builder Cove after a rainstorm threatens to flood the town; Rubble and Motor come up with crafty construction solutions to fix Farmer Zoe's squirrel problem before the Farm Fair.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S04 E03 — Pups Save a Playful Dragon; Pups Save the Critters
Buddy, the playful dragon from one of Alex's books, gets out and the pups need to get him back; Francois' trailer comes unhooked and all of his critters get loose.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S05 E02 — Pups Save Big Paw; Pups Save a Hum-Mover
When an ancient relic goes missing from Carlos' archaeological dig, Tracker and Skye must track down the creature that may have taken it; Mayor Humdinger pretends to break his toe to win a race.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S02 E10 — Pups Save a Talent Show; Pups Save the Corn Roast
The Pups help out the mayor in the Adventure Bay Talent Show; when Chickaletta gets trapped in a corn field maze, the PAW Patrol must come to the rescue.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S02 E15 — Pups Save a Friend; Pups Save a Stowaway
When Marshall begins to feel like his clumsy ways are ruining his friends' fun, he decides to take a break from the PAW Patrol and goes off to the woods; Cali becomes an unsuspecting stowaway when she is accidentally packed up into the Paw Patroller.

title: Peppa Pig
description:

description:

description:

description:

description:

description: The PAW Patrol pups magically gain superpowers after a meteor strikes Adventure City. However, things take a turn for the worse when Humdinger and a mad scientist steal their powers and turn themselves into supervillains.

description:

When Rocky Kitty runs away and tries to join the "PAW Patrol," he helps the pups rescue Humdinger and the kitties from a hang-glider ride; when the Good Neighbor Robots confuse Farmer Al's request, they wind up being the target of a hungry eagle.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S06 E09 — Mighty Pups, Super Paws: When Super Kitties Attack
When the Kitty Catastrophe crew gets superpowers, the little kittens cause big problems all over town.

title: PAW Patrol
description:

In Adventure Bay, a major bike race is underway, and nearly the entire town is participating; with so many bikes on the roads, maintaining safety is a challenge; Chase and his team of Safety and Rescue Pups are on the job.

description:

When Corny runs away from Farmer Al's farm during a blackout, the pups need to light the way to get them home safely; uncle Otis hurls down Jake's Mountain in a runaway mine car.

Mayor Goodway and farmer Al are ready for a day filled with skydiving fun; Alex and the Mini Patrol get locked inside the flounder.

Adventure Bay is getting a new airport! Sweetie tries to take the Princess' place at the grand opening.

description:

While Humdinger gets dressed for a day with his Hummy Mummy, the Humsquatch accidentally puts on the mayor's suit and takes his place; when a precious bone goes missing, the Pups' only chance at getting it back is to team up with Sweetie.

Tracker and Lucita Buena call on the Air Rescue Pups to help save an irreplaceable Mother Tree; it's then up to the Paw Patrol to fix Mr. Porter's ice cream freezer before everything melts!

A collection of the PAW Patrol's Ultimate Rescue missions.

When Mayor Humdinger's trash-compacting truck messes up the beach, Rocky's new Re-Use It Truck comes to the rescue; when a gift of armor for the Princess gets scattered all over town, Rocky uses his Re-Use It Truck to put the armor back together.

Farmer Al's harvest machine goes haywire and shakes up Adventure Bay, even threatening to rock the Lookout off its foundation; Farmer Al has a wild dream that the PAW Patrol must rescue him and Yumi when his animals start acting like humans.

description:
S12 E08 — Pups Stop a Topiary Tal; Pups Save a Hum-Ball
Mr. Park has a Chickaletta topiary, but when Digi and Tal try to help, things get worse; Humdinger creates havoc with a moose and geyser as he tours Yellowbone Park in his rolling Hum-Ball.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S03 E24 — Pups Save a Giant Plant; Pups Get Stuck
Mayor Goodway's gesture of goodwill gift grows out of control when it is planted in the wrong place; Marshall's fire truck becomes mysteriously magnetized.

description:

After Danny's baseball accident, Digi and Tal create a safety suit for him to wear, designed to protect him from danger; Francois' fancy fromage goes missing before the competition, so he enlists Squeak the mouse to lead the rescue.

description:

While delivering special pizza dough for a party, Alex and Mr. Porter get into an accident; a storm causes Skye to crash-land in the snow while on her way to Jake's Mountain.

description:
S03 E20 — Pups Get Skunked; Pups and a Whale of a Tale
When Everest gets sprayed by a skunk, the pups tell her delicately that she needs a bath; the pups fly north to help free a baby whale that is trapped under the ice.

Ryder and the pups must help get a surprise birthday cake up to Jake's cabin; the PAW Patrol must come to the rescue when Alex and Daring Danny X snowboard toward Risky Ridge.

description:

The pups must catch three baby pterodactyls after they hatch from fossilized eggs unearthed on an excavation dig.

Goby and Gil go on a quest to get a geode at the top of a volcano, then try to make it back to the Rocky Valley Rock Show in time to enter the contest for best rock.

The team must collect baby chicks that have ventured into the city.

Francois and a baby penguin get caught on the other side of a crevasse; Daring Danny wants a cool pet of his own.

title: PAW Patrol
description:

While celebrating Friendship Day, the pups must prevent Mayor Humdinger from ruining Adventure Bay's reputation as the friendliest town on the map.

description:

When the sculpture of all the townsfolk suddenly disappears, Chase joins Rubble & Crew to solve the case of the missing statue and build a brand new Science Center to help investigate.

description:

Rubble and Crew build a hair salon just in time for Grandpa Gravel's special photo; Motor and Lily make a shiny discovery worth celebrating.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S06 E03 — Pups Save a Melon Festival; Pups Save a Cow
Mayor Humdinger's plan to win the giant melon contest goes off the rails when his "melon" bounces away and causes chaos all over town; Farmer Al's truck gets stuck on a broken bridge.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S04 E05 — Pups Save a Sleepover; Pups Save the Carnival
Farmer Al's animals go missing during a sleepover; Cornelius escapes from the pig ride at the carnival, and all the prizes have gone missing too.

Cat-Pack members Wild and Shade team up with the Mighty Pups to stop a runaway rocket; when the Ruff-Ruff Pack swipes a priceless golden lion mask from the museum, Shade and Wild must help the PAW Patrol to retrieve the stolen artifact.

description:
S04 E23 — Pups Save Luke Stars; Pups Save Chicken Day
When Luke Stars gets stuck on a ledge, Ryder and Marshall rush to the rescue; Mayor Goodway's big plans for Chicken Day become threatened when the Chicken of Honor, Chickaletta, mysteriously disappears.

description:
S08 E01 — Pups Save a Runaway Rooster; Pups Save a Snowbound Cow
Chickaletta and Roosterio run away from a chicken show and get stuck on top of a runaway drone. When Bettina wanders up Jake's mountain and gets caught in a snowstorm, it's up to the PAW Patrol to bring her safely down.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S10 E09 — Pups Stop a Gold Finding Machine; Pups Help Mayor Humdinger Out of a Jam
The PAW Patrol springs into action when a digging machine goes out-of-control and takes Uncle Otis on a wild ride; Digi and Tal try to help Mayor Humdinger but leave the Mayor covered in jam, so the Pups must rescue him from hungry animals.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S06 E11 — The Kingdom of Sleepwell!
All is not well in the normally well-rested Kingdom of Sleepwell because Princess Deema can't fall asleep; her royal court comes to her aid, but even magic doesn't work.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:

The Sea Witch steals the Guppies' magical jewels so she can rule the Seven Seas; the Guppies must get their jewels back and stop her before it's too late.
